Aletheia shows what a conclusion rests on. Every figure here is computed from individual claims, each traceable to the page it came from. The question it exists to answer is not "which tool is best" — it is what evidence could disappear before this conclusion should?

AI coding economics is the first corpus, not the point. It is small on purpose: five priced models, twelve load-bearing claims, and zero of them independently corroborated. Where there is no measurement, it refuses to compute rather than substituting a plausible number. The refusals are the part worth reading.
